chief_complaint: Follow‑up and management of advanced chronic kidney disease (stage 4) with multiple cardiovascular and metabolic comorbidities, including recent colon cancer diagnosis.
history_of_present_illness: The patient is a 67‑year‑old man with a long history of type 2 diabetes, hypertension, coronary artery disease (post‑CABG) and progressive chronic kidney disease now stage 4, awaiting transplantation. In early 2019 he was diagnosed with malignant neoplasm of the colon and received oxaliplatin‑based chemotherapy. He has diabetic microvascular complications (non‑proliferative retinopathy, neuropathy, proteinuria, microalbuminuria) and anemia treated with epoetin. Recent visits (last recorded 2019‑10‑24) focus on cancer surveillance, renal monitoring, cardiovascular risk management and medication review. Laboratory data are missing (no recent BP, eGFR, lipid panel, or A1c trends). Polypharmacy is high (12 agents).
